sources.note: Main vendor homepage. Describes EHNOTE as cloud-based ophthalmology EHR platform serving 200+ practices in USA and India. Lists core modules: EHR, practice management, ASC charting, optical POS, patient engagement, inventory, RCM, analytics.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Lists certification details, pricing model (per-provider monthly), third-party dependencies: Carefluence Open API R4 for FHIR, DrFirst Rcopia for e-prescribing, EMR Direct for secure email, Concurred for fax.
Ophthalmology EHR product page. Details DICOM imaging, subspecialty templates, drawing pad, e-prescribing, ASC integration, MIPS dashboard, mobile access, visual acuity/IOP/refraction analytics.
Practice management page. Describes scheduling, billing/claims, 200+ reports, multi-location management, patient CRM, digital check-in/out, insurance verification, staff monitoring.

Specialty solutions page. Lists five supported specialties: ophthalmology, dental, gynecology, pediatrics, general physician. No mention of wound care. Each specialty has tailored templates and modules.

Patient portal page. Describes health record access, self-vision testing, secure messaging, chatbot, medicine reminders, SMS broadcasting, digital check-in, payment gateway, telemedicine integration, loyalty program.
General EHR features page. Mentions AI-powered analytics, e-prescriptions, ICD-11 coding, health information exchange, dental charts, ophthalmology investigation templates, IoT device integration.
Telemedicine page. Describes video consultations, pre-consultation forms with image/video collection, case documentation, integrated payments, mobile apps for iOS/Android.
Ophthalmologist-specific service page. Details subspecialty charting, multi-layered drawing pad, ASC system, DICOM imaging, telemedicine, mobile EMR, health information exchange.

Company about page. Founded by Amarnatha Reddy Midde (CEO) and Amarnath Reddy Chappidi (COO). Dr. Kuldeep Raizada as advisor. Global team based in Texas. Participates in AAO, ASCRS, HIMSS conferences.

SoftwareFinder listing. 5-star rating from 1 review (Oct 2023). Lists EHNOTE as cloud-based with mobile apps. Custom pricing. Describes comprehensive feature set including optical POS and inventory management.
